items.name: Programa Especial da Albufeira do Alto Rabagão
Regime de proteção das albufeiras de águas públicas classificadas (DL 107/2009)
items.diploma: Decreto-Lei n.º 107/2009, de 15 de maio; classificação pela Portaria n.º 522/2009, de 15 de maio (e alterações, p.ex. Portaria n.º 91/2010, e despachos posteriores de classificação)
items.status: em vigor — applies to ALL classified albufeiras, with or without plan (supplants revoked plans, e.g. Azibo and São Domingos since Mar 2026)
items.dataSource: GIS: DGT OGC API collection srup_albufeiras — https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/srup_albufeiras/items (192 polygon features, attributes: designacao, tipologia [Protegida/Condicionada/Utilização Livre], municipio, dtccs, serv_lei=PORT 522/2009) — same OGC API + dtcc-style filtering pdm already uses for srup_ran. Also SNIAmb MapServers Albufeiras_AguasPublicas and Lagoas_Lagos_AguasPublicas. Classification registry (living list): https://apambiente.pt/agua/lista-de-albufeiras-lagos-e-lagoas-classificados
items.notes: Statutory belts even without a plan: plano de água + zona terrestre de proteção of 500 m from NPA (1000 m for Alqueva), with an inner zona reservada of 100 m. The GIS layers give the water body polygon; the 500 m / 100 m belts must be buffered from the NPA line or taken from plan/program layers where digitized.

summary: Backbone = APA's official registry table (apambiente.pt, 'Lista de albufeiras, lagos e lagoas classificados', updated Jul 2025 with 2026 diplomas), cross-checked against DGT's SRUP layer and DRE diplomas. COUNTS: APA states 180 classified albufeiras (plus 16 classified lagoas/lagos); the DGT GIS layer srup_albufeiras has 192 polygon features (includes lagoas and some multi-part entries). 43 distinct POAAPs were ever approved, covering 50 albufeiras (six plans cover 2-3 albufeiras each: Touvedo/Alto Lindoso, Régua/Carrapatelo, Cabril/Bouçã/Sta Luzia, Sta Águeda/Pisco, Alqueva/Pedrógão, Funcho/Arade). As of mid-2026: 41 POAAPs em vigor (Azibo and São Domingos were REVOKED in Mar 2026 by RCM 52/2026 and 55/2026 — not transposed, protection reverted to the statutory DL 107/2009 regime; Crestuma-Lever partially suspended by RCM 60/2026). Exactly 1 PEAAP is em vigor: PEAFT Foz Tua (RCM 112/2026, 8 Jun 2026, first of its kind); ~17 programas especiais are em elaboração/determinada (heavy wave of despachos in 2024-2025 extending deadlines and launching new ones: Alto Rabagão, Montargil, Alvito, Alqueva/Pedrógão, Caia in Sep 2025). Three POAAPs had elaboration determined (Bemposta/Picote/Miranda 2007, Valeira/Pocinho 2007, Valtorno 2009) but were never approved. GIS caveats for pdm: (1) SNIAmb's POAAP MapServer (EPSG:3763, ArcGIS REST, Query+geoJSON supported — WMS/WFS endpoints returned errors when probed 2026-07-06) only has 11 plans' zonamento digitized (Apartadura, Caniçada, Castelo do Bode, Divor, Funcho e Arade, Montargil, Monte Novo, Monte da Rocha, Póvoa e Meadas, Roxo, Tapada Grande); the remaining ~30 plans exist only as APA document zips (plantas PDF/regulamento) at apambiente.pt/sites/default/files/_SNIAMB_Agua/DLPC/Albufeiras/POA/*.zip — expect georeferencing work. (2) PEAAP zoning lives in SNIAmb/PAAP_Sniamb MapServer with full INSPIRE-style layers (área de intervenção, plano de água, zona terrestre de proteção, zona reservada, NPA...), currently only Foz Tua. (3) For point-in-polygon 'is this coordinate near a classified albufeira' checks across all 308 municipalities, DGT's ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/srup_albufeiras is the easy win — same OGC API Features + municipio/dtccs attributes pdm already uses for srup_ran — but it holds the water-body polygon only; the DL 107/2009 statutory 500 m zona terrestre de proteção (1000 m Alqueva) and 100 m zona reservada must be derived by buffering unless a digitized plan layer exists. Municipality lists above come from the DGT srup_albufeiras 'municipio' attribute (authoritative for the albufeira itself); a plan's área de intervenção (water + 500-1000 m belt) can touch additional neighbouring municipalities, so for pdm the definitive per-plan municipality mapping should be computed by intersecting plan boundaries with CAOP. Ambiguities flagged: Bouçã/Figueiró dos Vinhos and PEARE neighbours; APA's '50 with POAAP' figure predates the two 2026 revocations (now 48 albufeiras covered)."
